name: Northrop Sweet
role: Early convert called to preach who soon left
dateNote: He was baptized by October 1830, and section 33 was given for him and Ezra Thayre that month.
importance: Section 33 calls him and Ezra Thayre to open their mouths and preach repentance. It tells them the field is white for harvest and to build the Church on the Lord’s rock. He moved to Kirtland and was ordained an elder by June 1831. Soon after, he left and helped found a small group called the Pure Church of Christ.
connections: Baptized by Parley P. Pratt and called with Ezra Thayre. He later farmed in Branch County, Michigan.
reviewNote: Birth (19 February 1802, New York), death (23 February 1881, Michigan), baptism, ordination, and later life checked on JSP. Section 33 names him only as “Northrop”, which is unambiguous in the D&C.
